current_hypothesis: Existing controlled conformance does not establish open-world language generalization; independent external challenge evidence is still required.
intended_contribution_this_revision: Make normalized triangle-intersection geometry invariant to representable physical scale and robust to large finite translations.

datasets_and_splits.authority: Applicable referenced frozen protocol; no dataset version or split is silently replaced.

baseline_failures_preserved.qualification: Failures include incorrect reported normalization scale as well as geometry/overflow failures; not all 14 are false intersection verdicts.
baseline_failures_preserved.environment_failure: An initial broader run could not import jsonschema. Isolated dependencies were installed and the four targeted test files then passed.

decisions.observation: A one-millimeter normalization floor made tolerances effectively absolute for small meshes, causing scale-dependent intersection decisions. Computing (min+max)/2 could overflow for finite translated vertices.
decisions.hypothesized_cause: A one-millimeter normalization floor made tolerances effectively absolute for small meshes, causing scale-dependent intersection decisions. Computing (min+max)/2 could overflow for finite translated vertices.
decisions.change: Normalize by actual maximum mesh extent, center with half-weighted extrema, and reject zero or unrepresentable extent before geometric predicates.
decisions.predicted_consequence: Four analytically chosen intersection/nonintersection fixtures preserve their verdict from 1e-180 to 1e160; a representable mesh near 1e308 can be centered without overflow.
decisions.discriminating_experiment: Compare the new regression fixtures with the original base source, then run relevant existing checks.
decisions.result: See retained verification receipt; no efficacy result is inferred.

claim_evidence.claim: Make normalized triangle-intersection geometry invariant to representable physical scale and robust to large finite translations.

claim_evidence.figure_or_table: No scientific figure or table generated

limitations: Inputs whose total span is not representable in float64 are rejected explicitly. These checks do not establish physical validity, kernel-backed solid correctness, safety, or language generalization.
